summary: Phase 3a complete: proved mem_omegaLanguage_drop and omegaLanguage_untl (semantic equation for the Until language via Stream.drop). Phase 3b blocked: direct NBA construction for isRegular_untl requires subset/power-set construction tracking multiple simultaneous Büchi-accepting runs. No progress on Phase 3c. The proof_wanted Formula.isRegular_untl remains unchanged.

blockers.description: The guard check 'v.drop k in L(phi) for all k < j' requires verifying multiple independent Büchi-accepting runs (one per position 0..j-1). The correct NBA construction tracks the set of all active phi-runs (subset construction, state space Finset S_phi). The correctness proof requires showing: (1) completeness via constructing the subset-tracking run from any accepting configuration, and (2) soundness via extracting per-position accepting runs from the accumulated subset state. This is 8-15 hours of implementation work.

proved_lemmas: mem_omegaLanguage_drop: v.drop k ∈ φ.omegaLanguage ↔ Satisfies (fun n p => p ∈ v n) k φ
omegaLanguage_untl: (Formula.untl φ ψ).omegaLanguage = ⟨{ v | ∃ j, v.drop j ∈ ψ.omegaLanguage ∧ ∀ k < j, v.drop k ∈ φ.omegaLanguage }⟩
continuation_context.remaining_work: Phase 3b: implement untlNBA (direct NBA with subset-tracking state space Finset S_phi × Option S_psi × Bool) and prove untlNBA_language_eq. Then Phase 3c: prove Formula.isRegular_untl using the NBA, replace sorry in Formula.isRegular.
continuation_context.approach: Subset-tracking NBA: states = (active: Finset S_phi) × (accepted: Finset S_phi) × (ψ-state: Option S_psi) × (mode: Bool). Guard mode: advance phi-copies and add fresh starts. Event mode: track psi. Acceptance: GNBA with F_phi = (active ⊆ accepted AND in event mode) and F_psi = (psi in accept AND in event mode). Convert GNBA to NBA via interNA toggle.

artifacts.summary: mem_omegaLanguage_drop + omegaLanguage_untl proved (sorry-free). proof_wanted isRegular_untl unchanged.
